answer: Join quotas with a rising entry auction cap new identities at 20 per epoch, and the minimum bid doubles every 5 admissions, starting at 1 POA. A farm minting a pearl-sized swarm pays 1 POA for the first fakes but 32 POA by the 30th, so each extra identity costs more than the last. Bids are escrowed on the ledger, forfeited if peers flag the account, and any node can recompute the price curve, so no ledge of cheap slots exists to echo.
